about:
Boston Semi Equipment (BSE) is headquartered in Littleton, Massachusetts. The company was founded to address the growing need for flexible IC test solutions, focusing on solving complex technology problems with production-ready electronic test handling equipment built for the long haul.

BSE designs and manufactures gravity and pick-and-place test handlers under the Zeus and Panacea product lines, including variants for tri-temperature, MEMS, high-voltage, and high-accuracy applications. The company also provides handler services, OEM contract services, and comprehensive test cell support encompassing installation, warranty, training, parts replacement, field service, relocation, repair, and calibration. Its ISO-certified repair facilities in Thailand and the Philippines, along with regional logistics centers and an automated eMV service portal, support a global installed base of legacy ATE equipment.

BSE serves the automotive, electrification (wide-bandgap semiconductors), collaborative technology (connectivity and smart devices), aerospace, medical (MEMS), and AI and big data markets. Its customers include semiconductor device manufacturers and test houses that require both new test handler platforms and long-term support for legacy automatic test equipment.

The company emphasizes close customer partnerships as its core differentiator, stating that its biggest accomplishments result from collaborations that push the edges of technology to deliver exceptional value for today and tomorrow.
